content.title: Who is homeless in Arvada and why?
content.summary: Losing stable housing can happen to anyone – men, women, families, children, youth, seniors, and veterans. Recent data show that in Jefferson County, 77% of those experiencing homelessness are families with children. Most people (94%) say they did not choose to be homeless
